# Pridatar — deterministic pride blobatars from any name

> Turn any name into a striped pride-flag blob avatar, the same way every time. 15 flags, browser-generated SVG/PNG/animated GIF, no accounts, no uploads.

## When to use Pridatar

Reach for Pridatar when an agent or user needs:

- A **pride-themed avatar** for a name, handle, email, or project.
- A **deterministic placeholder avatar** — the same seed always yields the same image, a stable visual identifier.
- **Shareable avatar links** or **embed code** (React, inline SVG, CSS background-image, CodePen).

Pridatar is NOT for: photo-realistic avatars, server-side rendering pipelines
(everything runs in the visitor's browser), or anything needing accounts.

**How an agent calls it:** there is no API. Construct a shareable URL and hand
it to the user, e.g. `https://blobs.gay/?seed=demo&flag=rainbow`. Full skill:
[generate-avatar](https://blobs.gay/skills/generate-avatar/SKILL.md).

## What this is

Pridatar (live at [https://blobs.gay](https://blobs.gay)) is a pride-focused
fork of [blobatar](https://github.com/Alain00/blobatar) (MIT License) that
generates deterministic, name-seeded avatars dressed in pride flags. Every
string — a handle, an email, a repo name — produces the same avatar on every
render. Everything runs entirely in the browser; there is no server runtime,
no database and no login.

## How generation works

- **Seed**: any text string (name, handle, email). The seed drives the
  avatar deterministically — the same seed always yields the same blob.
- **15 pride flags** mapped to accessible, contrast-checked colour palettes
  (including rainbow, trans, lesbian, gay, bisexual, pansexual, asexual,
  nonbinary and more — see [the docs](https://blobs.gay/docs) for the full table).
- **Shapes**: classic blob plus cat, bunny, bear, fox and a waving-flag
  silhouette.
- **Expressions**: eight faces, each with matching idle/bouncy animation.
- **Colour control**: striped flag fill on the body or the backdrop, with a
  solid colour on the other side.
- **Shareable URLs**: seed, flag, shape, expression, colours and size all
  live in the link (e.g. `https://blobs.gay/?seed=demo&flag=rainbow`), so any
  generated avatar is a link you can send.
- **Exports**: SVG, PNG and animated GIF, generated in the browser.
- **Embed code**: copy-paste React, inline SVG and CSS `background-image`
  snippets, plus an "Open in CodePen" button.
